binding.content_hash: Consumers hash canonical JSON of this policy, excluding no fields, and store that hash in plans/reports. This file has no self-hash.
binding.changes: Any revision creates a new pinned policy identity; invalidate consuming plans/reports. No solver may change the policy.

scope.synthetic_fixture_semantics: Independently authored fixtures test interfaces and mathematics only. They cannot set real-scene execution_valid, quality_accepted or export_valid and cannot certify a real native decoder.

grouping.prospective_mode: Freeze policy before additional outcomes; state prior metadata/exposure and unknown history. Do not call this an untouched holdout.
grouping.same_object_split: Within-development stress test only; all three clips remain together for object-generalization claims.
grouping.selection_rule: Every outcome used to choose models, thresholds, observations, prompts or candidates becomes development evidence.
grouping.pooling: Episode-local reconstruction; group assignment grants no cross-episode asset/camera/human sharing.

observation_protocol.source: Hash original encoded Track 1 bytes, decoder identity, full display-order original frame IDs and rational PTS.
observation_protocol.observations: Pin entity, frame IDs, raw/model/human origin, producer, validity, image transforms, visibility and derivation lineage. Task text only proposes events.
observation_protocol.partitions: Explicit observation/frame lists and selection method/config/time before fitting; fit/review lineage disjoint, temporal buffer declared per case.
observation_protocol.review_independence: Declare the exclusion boundary. Whole-video estimator consumption means review pixels are not held out from that estimator; they may be reserved only from a later local repair.
observation_protocol.correlation: Record shared video, producer/model and temporal dependencies; masks/depth/model agreement is not independent ground truth.
observation_protocol.anchors: Select with predeclared visibility/information criteria using fit evidence only. R1 first reference ID remains unchanged.
observation_protocol.corrections: Append new human observations with previous IDs, evidence and rationale; corrections inherit duplicate lineage and do not restore independence.
observation_protocol.unknowns: Keep unobserved visibility/geometry/contact/rotation components unknown, with explicit estimates on all required output frames.
observation_protocol.weights: Freeze residual normalization, units and confidence-weight rules; optimizer may not reduce confidence to hide errors.

structural_checks.rule: Versioned envelope, safe relative refs, exact content hashes and complete allowed provenance; reject v1/fake as a real v2 scene.
Source decode has exact expected episode/object membership, 0..T-1 IDs, valid rational PTS; state covers every frame including occlusion.
Observation transforms, source dimensions, validity/visibility semantics and partition lineage are explicit and internally consistent.
Native pose[T,136], static scales[68], static shape[45], finite values and exact rig/decoder/conversion identities; array dimensions alone do not establish native correctness.
Named metric scene frame, proper SO(3), constant positive object scale, mesh hash/canonical transform/origin binding, exactly-once scale.
One atomic native scene; bootstrap and consumed native estimates have separate roles; no independent latest-file mixing.
Changes invalidate recorded descendants; all required reports match current scene hash and validator/config hashes.
Repair is an allowed bounded operation on an execution-valid parent with exact fixed/mutable blocks, rollback and predeclared budgets.
Export exact selected scene, original frame/object manifest and generating code identity; reload/decode/compiled-geometry checks before export validity.

repair_registry.unsupported_operations: Reject any operation outside this list; listed operations are not evidence that a solver is implemented.
repair_registry.budget_values: Positive finite case-specific values frozen before fitting; no global numeric defaults accepted by implication.
repair_registry.global_revisions: Camera, mesh/origin/scale, representation and human identity changes are preparation revisions with descendant invalidation, outside this repair registry.
repair_registry.failure: Stop on timeout, budget violation or failed checks; retain candidate/logs and an execution-valid parent. Invalid initial outputs never become a fallback.
repair_registry.final_fallback: A retained execution-only parent is not automatically an accepted reconstruction/export; independently require quality and export gates.

quality_protocol.enable_after: Real P2 baseline characterization and frozen case acceptance config before candidate fitting/ranking.

metrics.limits: State full image versus crop and fit/review partition; segmentation is estimated.
Use explicit validity and original-image transforms; review landmarks may be human annotations.
Evaluate simultaneous grasp/sliding/support/foot relations; low penetration alone does not prove contact.
Consecutive original IDs only; never reference-relative ACC or independent accuracy.
Report observable/symmetric ambiguity and image evidence; smooth wrong rotations can fail.
Separate decoder mapping, shared-identity fitting and packer/mesh-budget changes; tolerance frozen for selected decoder.
Exact accepted scene and compiled mesh/pose; not reconstruction accuracy.
Record hardware and measured scope; kernel timing is not end-to-end throughput.

quality_protocol.aggregation: Report failures and per-episode/worst-case outcomes with separate metrics. No invented official composite or hidden-reference score.

decision_protocol.real_execution: Passing structural metadata checks alone does not authorize execution_valid; require permitted real inputs, complete actual invocation outputs and verified native conversion.
decision_protocol.quality: execution_valid plus independent-within-declared-scope review and frozen full-clip acceptance report required.
decision_protocol.export: execution_valid plus exact-scene pack/reload/decode/geometry and expected-manifest report required.
decision_protocol.promotion: Accepted scene requires execution_valid and quality_accepted; final submission candidate also requires export_valid. Atomic promotion must match parent and all input hashes.
decision_protocol.conflict_or_missing_evidence: Unresolved; no automatic acceptance or silent exclusion of failed clips.

rules: Append-only; retain rejected and superseded interventions.
No per-episode hidden solver patch or unrecorded manual selection.
Data corrections create a new evidence version and invalidate consumers.
Record time/candidate/annotation effort separately from model compute.

failure_taxonomy.meaning: Hash/path/version mismatch, unsafe path or in-place mutation
Missing/duplicate/reordered source IDs, missing occluded frames or bad timestamps
Wrong actor/object or unresolved identity swap
Crop/intrinsic mapping mismatch, invalid unknown-pixel encoding or broken lineage
Reserved observations used to fit, tune or select, including corrected duplicates
Wrong native rig/units/parameter mapping or decoder mismatch
Mixed scene versions, wrong mesh/canonical origin/scale/pose pairing
Consumed dependency changed; descendants/reports no longer match
Bootstrap/native inconsistency or unexplained monocular scale solution
Unsupported topology, concealed shape hypothesis, holes/contact surfaces wrong
Unobserved/symmetric orientation or wrong visible face
Lost grasp/support, incorrect sticking/sliding or stale contact after repair
Ambiguous hidden motion or failed reappearance/boundary fit
Repair breaks neighboring windows, anchors or full-clip checks
Unapproved variable change, unsupported operation or exceeded resource/candidate budget
Wrong payload frame/object membership or changed decoded geometry
Exception, missing native output, unsupported hardware or nonfinite state

verification_boundary: This JSON is a pinned protocol record, not a claim that every listed check is implemented or passed. Current executable validators must report their implemented scope and leave unsupported checks not_run.
